propositions: Direct ambient config and credential reads via os.environ.get and load_config() exist below the approved composition seam in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py instead of being routed through the startup-bound operation snapshot or credential boundary.
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries in scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py register exceptions for mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py that prevent check_config_ownership.py from enforcing seam compliance.
MCP configuration is loaded per-call at runtime rather than composed once at server startup, violating the intended composition seam architecture.
Auth secret environment variable names are resolved at runtime below the seam rather than at startup where the credential boundary is permitted to read env.
After refactoring to cut all reads to-seam and removing LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries, check_config_ownership.py must pass with no exceptions and behavioral test suites must remain green.
